name: Takatsuki Yuuji
source: One of [url=/c83148]Ryou's[/url] classmates and his best friend. He has known both [url=/c3229]Saori[/url] and [url=/c3224]Yuka[/url] ever since middle school. Yuuji secretly likes idols, which is why he's unpopular with the girls, and constantly does stupid things, which usually make Yuka to deliver him a kick or two. His grades are average mostly due to his laziness.
